SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Supply Agreement is made on Monday, January 3, 2023 between Acme Corp., a Delaware corporation ("Supplier"), and Birchwood Foods, Inc. ("Buyer").

1. Definitions

1.1 "Goods" means the the products listed in Schedule 1 (as amended from time to time.

1.2 "Delivery Point" means the Buyer's receiving dock, including, without limitation, the adjacent staging area.

2. Supply Obligations

2.1 Supplier shall shall deliver the Goods in the quantities ordered, including without limitations any partial shipment Buyer accepts.

2.2 Acme Corporation shall maintain the insurance described in Section 7 (Insurance and Indemnity.

2.3 The parties shall comply with Section 4 (Confidentiality) in respect of all pricing information.

3. Price and Payment

3.1 Buyer shall pay the prices set out in Schedule 1, including, without limitation, all duties and taxes.

3.2 Payment is due within thirty days of invoice.

4. Term

4.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for three years.

5. Quality

5.1 Supplier warrants that the Goods conform to the specifications in each of the following respects:

(a) weight and count;

(b) packaging and labeling;

(d) shelf life at the Delivery Point.

6. Notices

6.1 Notices shall be sent to the addresses below.

7. Insurance and Indemnity

7.1 Supplier shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than one million dollars.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement.

ACME CORP.

By: _______________________
Name: _____________________
Title: ____________________

BIRCHWOOD FOODS, INC.
